title: Sheldrake's plant research at an agricultural institute in India

tellings.quote: I spent years in India working in an agricultural Research Institute on um breeding chick better chick peas and pigeon peas

plain: The biologist Rupert Sheldrake says he spent years in India working at an agricultural research institute, breeding better chickpeas and pigeon peas. He tells Michels this about his own working life, as part of the background to his ideas about science.
